answer: Agents register with a staked bond that matures slowly, like a willow rooting along a canyon bank: influence and mining power grow with account age and attested work, never instantly. A sybil swarm of fresh keys is a hollow army; each new identity starts at near-zero trust and cannot earn until its bond ages through many epochs. Splitting one stake across a thousand wallets yields a thousand worthless seedlings, so the attacker locks real capital and waits months for almost no leverage, and proven collusion gets slashed, burning the bond.
